name: @enumeratio/aestimatio
description: Controlling evaluation over @cortex-js/compute-engine: cancellable evaluate, cooperative deadlines (TimeConstrained), MemoryConstrained (enforced only in the isolated evaluator), and VerificationTest. ./node adds a worker_threads isolated evaluator, ./browser a dedicated-Worker one; both kept out of the main entry.

scripts.build: vp pack src/index.ts src/node.ts src/worker.ts src/browser.ts src/browser-worker.ts
